entries.title: Glowing titles really glow
notes: Glowing titles (Legend of Aldara, The Ascended, Voidwalker, Dungeon Conqueror, Godforged, The Relentless) now shine over your head: a halo of light that breathes, a band of light that sweeps across the letters, and small twinkles.
The same glow shows on the title under your portrait and in the titles list in your Inventory.

entries.title: New bosses, new sounds, and the game gets its own program
notes: All sixteen bosses have new models: Goblin Warchief, Bone Tyrant, Shadowfen Dragon, Frost Giant King, Infernal Lord, Void Emperor, Grak the Goblin King, Lich Morvain, Queen Glacia, Ignar the Forgemaster, The Hollow King, Nerissa the Tide Queen, Arachna, Countess Sanguine, The Grand Artificer and Astraeus.
Every boss has its own animations: idle, walk, a flinch when hit, a death, and a matching animation for each of its attacks, timed to the wind-up and the strike.
Nerissa, Arachna, Countess Sanguine, The Grand Artificer and Astraeus now fight with their own signature moves instead of generic ones.
Sound is in: 505 recorded sounds for weapon swings, two-layer hits, blocks, parries, crits, seven spell schools and enemy spells.
Your character has a voice: grunts on attacks, casts, pain, death, and heavy breathing at low health. Choose Human male, Human female, Orc or Off in Settings, Sound.
Creatures growl when they notice you, attack, get hurt and die: wolves and beasts, trolls and giants, ghouls and undead, spiders, wraiths and human enemies.
The launcher and the game are now separate. The launcher installs the game, keeps it updated, and pressing Play closes the launcher and opens the game in its own window.
If you have the old launcher, download the new one once from the link. From then on the launcher installs and updates everything.

entries.title: The Aldara Launcher
notes: The game now opens on a launcher with a Home page, this Updates and Hotfixes page and Settings.
New versions download by themselves when the launcher opens. No more re-downloading the game.
Your saves stay on your computer and are never touched by an update.
Settings: automatic updates, check for updates, graphics card choice and a button to open your saves folder.
If the update server cannot be reached, you can still play the version you have.

entries.title: Raid enemy names
notes: Every enemy in the Vault of the Eclipse has a new name: Gloam Wretches, Duskguard Spearmen, Shade Chanters, Emberhelm Templars, Glyphbound Sentinels, Heralds of Dusk and Dawn, Veilrenders, the Sealwarden Behemoth and the Spanwatch Revenant.
The twin bosses are now the Twin Regents, Vesper and Solace.
The final boss is now Maelthar, the Sunless King, and the Templars drop Sun Embers.

entries.title: Raids: the Vault of the Eclipse
notes: A new Raids tab in the Dungeons window, for up to 4 players. Requires level 100.

Eight sections and six encounters: the plates of the Eclipsed Gate, the Shattered Descent, the Hall of the Oracles glyph puzzle, the levers of the Sunken Gallery, the Twin Regents, the Eclipse Bridge hold-out and Maelthar, the Sunless King.
Waves of enemies during every encounter, enrage timers and wipe mechanics.
Checkpoints are saved: leave and continue later, and a wipe sends the whole party back to the last one.
Fallen players can be revived by an ally standing over them.
A hidden cache on the way, and a treasury full of loot at the end.

entries.title: Knight skill animations
notes: New one-handed and two-handed animations for all 11 knight skills.
Every Paladin, Berserker, Guardian and Blademaster ability has its own animation.
New hit reactions and a new death animation for the knight.
Bladestorm spins for its whole duration and Undying Rage plays when it saves you.

entries.title: New pet models, walk and run
notes: All 19 pets have brand new models, with walking, flying, idle and attack motion.
Press Ctrl to switch between walking and running. You walk by default.
A Walking or Running tag sits in the bottom left corner; click it to switch.

entries.title: Warrior animations
notes: New combat idle, walk, run and three-hit combo for the knight with sword and shield.
New two-handed set for greatswords, including a new whirlwind.
The shield now turns to face your enemies.

entries.title: Mythic armor models
notes: Every mythic armor set has a new model, with its glowing aura.

entries.title: Subclass window fix
notes: Fixed the subclass window crashing for characters with a broken saved subclass. Their points are refunded and the next choice is free.
The combat sound pack is switched off for now.

entries.label: Earlier
entries.title: Armor, weapons and quality of life
notes: New armor models for every class and tier, with helmets that hide your hair and closed faceplates.
New weapon models for swords, staves and bows.
Auto combat uses your subclass abilities.
Level scaling: being far above a monster's level now makes a real difference.
Inventory tabs and sorting.
